sentences.en: The substance is light enough to float on the water.
sentences.zh: 这种物质轻到可以在水面上漂浮。

sentences.en: The fisherman saved himself by means of a floating board.
sentences.zh: 渔夫利用一块漂浮的木板救了自己。

sentences.en: A fallen leaf floated on the surface of the water.
sentences.zh: 一片落叶在水面漂浮着。
